title: 15. Billina Frightens the Nome King
chineseTitle: 15. 比莉娜吓退 Nome 王

paragraphs.en: After Dorothy entered the palace to make her guesses, the Scarecrow and the Nome King sat in silence for a few minutes. Then the king said, "Very good!" The Scarecrow asked, "Who is very good?"
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西进入宫殿开始猜测后，稻草人和诺姆国王沉默了片刻。随后，国王说道：“很好！”稻草人问道：“是谁做得很好？”

paragraphs.en: The king replied, "The machine man. He won't need winding up anymore; he's now a neat ornament."
paragraphs.zh: 国王回答说：“那个机械人。他再也不需要上发条了；现在他成了一个不错的装饰品。”
